name: io.github.tonyyang0504/usajobs-mcp
description: USAJOBS (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_USAJOBS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: USAJOBS API key requested on https://developer.usajobs.gov/ (free); sent as the Authorization-Key header on every call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_USAJOBS_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The e-mail address registered with the API key; USAJOBS requires it as the User-Agent header on every call.
